headline: U.S. Threatens Imminent Military Action Against Iran, Seizing Global Energy Markets
summary: The U.S. President's declaration of an imminent military strike on Iran, coupled with threats to seize energy markets, signals a drastic escalation of geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. This development is poised to trigger a severe global energy crisis, disrupt shipping lanes, and inflate producer prices, profoundly impacting all supply chains and global economic stability.
